title: Restriction triangle has cone supported on the closed complement
statement: Let Y be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let V be a quasi-compact open subscheme with open immersion j:V \to Y, and let K be an object of D_QCoh(Y) [def-pc-derived-category]. Then there is a distinguished triangle K \to Rj_*Lj^*K \to Q \to K[1] in D_QCoh(Y) [def-pc-derived-direct-image], where all cohomology sheaves of Q are supported on Y\setminus V. If K belongs to D_QCoh^+(Y), then Q belongs to D_QCoh^+(Y).

source.place: Tag 0E4G (Lemma 48.4.3), proof; Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemmas 36.4.1 and Definition 36.6.1

proof.text: Transport Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction along Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv. Exact restriction and the existing mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction API produce the adjunction to the same rightDerivedFunctor used by schemeDerivedDirectImage. Its right adjoint preserves K-injective complexes by Adjunction.preservesKInjectiveComplexes. The underived pushforward is fully faithful, hence the proved full_rightDerivedFunctor and faithful_rightDerivedFunctor instances make its derived functor fully faithful.

source.place: Tag 0E4G (Lemma 48.4.3), proof; Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemmas 36.4.1 and Definition 36.6.1

proof.text: Use schemeDerivedQCoh_openRestriction_iff and isQuasicoherent_over to prove quasi-coherence after exact restriction. Compactness of V and quasi-separatedness of Y give QuasiCompact V.ι; an open immersion is separated. Apply schemeDerivedDirectImage_preserves_QCoh. Specialize supported_qcoh_isTriangulated to the support subset Set.univ, so its property is just quasi-coherent cohomology. ObjectProperty.distinguished_cocone_triangle completes the derived unit with a quasi-coherent third vertex.

source.place: Tag 0E4G (Lemma 48.4.3), proof; Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemmas 36.4.1 and Definition 36.6.1

proof.text: The fully faithful right adjoint has invertible counit. By the left triangle identity and isIso_of_comp_hom_eq_id the image of the unit under derived restriction is invertible. map_distinguished and Triangle.isZero₃_of_isIso₁ show the restriction of Q is zero. mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso makes the restriction of each cohomology sheaf zero. Transport to Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor by overFunctorEquiv, apply the additive stalk functor at (x,hx), and use restrictStalkNatIso and AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero to obtain the required vanishing stalk on V.

source.place: Tag 0E4G (Lemma 48.4.3), proof; Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemmas 36.4.1 and Definition 36.6.1

proof.text: Exact restriction preserves a lower bound by Functor.isGE_mapDerivedCategory_obj. Put the restricted object in DerivedCategory.Plus and apply rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility: the object R.rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj E already has a bounded-below certificate, which is transported to unbounded derived direct image. The canonical t-structure plus property is triangulated, so ext_of_isTriangulatedClosed₃ proves bounded-below cohomology of Q from that of the first two vertices.

lean.statement: theorem openRestriction_support_triangle (Y : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y] (V : Y.Opens) (hV : IsCompact (V : Set Y)) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace))] (K : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (hK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y K) : ∃ (adj : (schemeOpenRestriction Y V).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage V.ι) (Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (β : (schemeDerivedDirectImage V.ι).obj ((schemeOpenRestriction Y V).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ⟶ Q) (δ : Q ⟶ K⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧), Triangle.mk (adj.unit.app K) β δ ∈ distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory Y) ∧ schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y ((schemeDerivedDirectImage V.ι).obj ((schemeOpenRestriction Y V).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)) ∧ schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y Q ∧ (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : Y), x ∈ V → Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) n).obj Q).val.presheaf x))) ∧ ((∃ a : ℤ, K.IsGE a) → ∃ b : ℤ, Q.IsGE b)
